go
m.f. [ts] (sg. nom. go; acc. gavaṃ, gāvuṃ, gaṃ; dat./gen. gavassa1; abl. gavā; loc. gave; pl. nom. gāvo, gavā; acc. gāvo; instr. gohi; gen. gavaṃ, gunnaṃ; loc. gosu; see also Sadd 209,.6 foll.; 214,.32 foll.; iic go- and, esp. before initial vowel, gava1- qv; ifc -gava1, -gu3, -go); 1. (m.) an ox; (f.) a cow; (pl.) cattle; Abh 495 (goṇo go vasabho vuso); 498 (gāvī ca siṅginī go ca); 869 (go pumitthiyaṃ); Vin I 150,.9 (gāvuṃ vā te demi gāviṃ vā te demi); D I 201,.25 (gavā khīraṃ khīramhi dadhi …); M I 429,.32 (yadi vā gavassa yadi vā mahisassa …); S I 6,9* (gomiko gohi tath’ eva nandati) = Sn 33; S I 221,34* (ajjhārūhati dummedho go va bhiyyo palāyinaṃ); IV 181,.12 foll. (tena hi tvaṃ Nanda sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādehī ti, gamissanti bhante gāvo vacchagiddhiniyo ti); A I 162,12* (gosu pārevatāsu vā); II 42,.16 (yathārūpe … yaññe gāvo haññanti); 75,33* (gunnaṃ ce taramānānaṃ jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo sabbā tā jiṃhaṃ gacchanti) ≠ Ja III 111,17* (gavaṃ ce taramānānaṃ); Sn 296 (gāvo no paramā mittā yāsu jāyanti osadhā); 310 (adhammo iti pakkanduṃ yaṃ satthaṃ nipatī gave; Pj II 323,.33 : yasmā gāvimhi satthaṃ nipatī ti vuttaṃ hoti); 580 (ekameko va maccānaṃ go vajjho viya niyyati); Ja I 336,11* (usabhā rukkhā gāviyo gavā ca); II 428,19* (ahaṃ gāmavaraṃ icche brāhmaṇī ca gavaṃ sataṃ); IV 481,12* (gavaṃ va naṭṭhaṃ puriso yathā vane pariyesatī); V 15,27* (āhiṇḍatī go-r-iva bhakkhasādī; 18,21´ : go-r-ivā ti goṇo viya); Cp 1:9:26 (datvā dāsidāsaṃ gavaṃ dhanaṃ; Cp-a 85,.20 : gavan ti dhenuṃ); Mil 267,.21 (atthi hatthī assā gāvo mahisā …); Vism 166,.33 (gopo ekasmiṃ vaje sabbā gāvo samāharati); — ifc see kūṭago (sv kūṭa2), dammago (sv dammati), paṭṭhitago (sv paṭṭhita); — see also cittagu (sv citta2), jaraggava (sv jara1), tiṭṭhagu, digu (sv dvi); — 2. (m.) an organ of sense; Sadd 241,13* (go goṇe c’ indriye … vattate); 241,.18 (gāvo cakkhādīn’ indriyāni caranti etthā ti gocaro); — 3. (m.) the earth; Abh 181 (vasumatī go ku); Sadd 241,13* (go … bhumyaṃ … vattate); Ps III 435,.29 (go ti hi paṭhaviyā nāmaṃ); — 4. (m.) speech; under-standing; Sadd 241,13* (go … vacane c’ eva buddhiyaṃ … vattate); 241,.28 foll. (ten’ āhu porāṇā gan tāyatī ti gottaṃ, Gotamo ti hi pavattamānaṃ gaṃ vacanaṃ buddhiṃ ca tāyati ekaṃsikavisayatāya rakkhatī ti gottaṃ); — 5. (m.) the sun; Sadd 241,14* (go … ādicce … vattate); 242,.12 (gosaddo ādicce vattati gogottaṃ Gotamaṃ name ti); — 6. (m.) a ray of light; Sadd 241,14* (go … rasmiyaṃ … vattate); 242,.21 (uṇhā gāvo rasmiyo etassā ti uṇhagu suriyo); — see also uṇhagu (sv uṇha); — 7. (m.) water; Sadd 241,14* (go … pānīye pi ca vattate); 242,.24 (gosītacandanan ti … gosaddena hi jalaṃ vuccati, go viya sītaṃ candanaṃ); —      °-kaṇṭaka,   m. [go + kaṇṭaka1], 1. a plant, SAF: small caltrops, Turkey blossom, Tribulus terrestris L.; Abh 583 (~o ca siṅghāṭo); — 2. a sharp clod churned up by cattle; Kkh2 151,.24; Sp 756,.18 (~o nāma gāvīnaṃ khuracchinnakaddamo vuccati); 1088,.4 (te kira ~e ekapaṭalikā upāhanā rakkhituṃ na sakkonti); — ~-hata, mfn., churned into sharp clods by cattle; Vin I 195,.37 (kaṇhuttarā bhūmi kharā ~-hatā) ≠ A I 136,.32 (Mp II 225,.11 foll. : navavaṭṭhe deve gāvīhi akkantakkantaṭṭhāne khurantarehi kaddamo uggantvā tiṭṭhati, so vātātapena sukkho kakacadantasadiso hoti dukkhasamphasso … gunnaṃ khurantarehi chinnā ti pi attho); —       °-kaṇṇa,   m., 1. a span; Abh 267; — 2. a kind of deer or elk; Abh 612 (~o gaṇikaṇṭakā); Ja III 75,.22 (eko sūkaro eko ~o eko mahiso eko gavayo …); V 406,30´ (gaṇino ti ~ā); Ps I 120,.9 (in cpd); Ap-a 536,10*; — gokaṇṇā [ti] in Ee at Sv 834,.20 is wr for gokāṇā qv; —       °-kaṇṇaka,   m., a kind of arrow;? a spike;? Mhv 76:48 (tikkhagge vāraṇatthāya vāraṇānaṃ ayomaye ~e nekasatasahassagaṇite; vl gokaṇṭake); —       °-kāṇā,   f. [go + kāṇa1], a cow blind in one eye; D III 38,.14 foll. (Be, Ee, Se so; Ce go kāṇā; Sv 834,.20 : ~ā ti ekakkhihatā kāṇā gāvī, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr gokaṇṇā ti); 53,.18 (~aṃ pariyantacāriniṃ karotha); —       °-kula,   n., a cattle-shed; a cow-pen; Abh 190 (goṭṭhaṃ tu ~aṃ vajo); S IV 289,.5 (adhivāsentu me therā svātanāya ~e bhattan ti); Ja VI 297,18´; —       °-khāyitaka,   mfn., (to be) grazed by cattle; Vism 415,.3 (sassesu pana ~-mattesu jātesu; Vism-mhṭ [Be] II 50,.22 : gohi khāditabbappamāṇesu) = Paṭis-a 368,.12 (Be, Ce so; Ee, Se °-khāyitamattesu); Sadd 327,.20; —       °-gavesa,   mfn., searching for cattle; Ja V 70,1* (eko caraṃ ~o mūḷho accasariṃ vane; 72,13´ : naṭṭhagoṇe gavesanto); —       °-ghaṃsikā,   f., a “cow-rubber”? a roller, a rod; Vin II 117,.30 (kaṭhinaṃ paribhijjati, anujānāmi bhikkhave ~āya kaṭhinaṃ saṅgharitun ti kaṭhinaṃ viveṭhiyati …; Sp 1207,.3 : ~āyā ti veḷuṃ vā rukkhadaṇḍakaṃ vā anto katvā tena saddhiṃ saṅgharitun ti attho); —       °-ghātaka,   m. [go + ghātaka1], one who kills cows, a butcher; Vin III 105,.30 (Sp 508,.13 : ~o ti gāvo vadhitvā vadhitvā aṭṭhito maṃsaṃ mocetvā vikkiṇitvā jīvikaṃ kappanakasatto); D II 294,.18; A III 302,.15; Ja V 270,4* (corā ~ā luddā); Vism 348,.14; —       °-ghātana,   n., cattle-killing, cow-slaughter; Pj II 323,.25 (taṃ ~aṃ disvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-ghātakaṃ); —       °-cara,   m. [cf S., BHS gocara] 1. grazing; a search for food; where and on what animals feed; the particular feeding-ground, the particular food of an animal; Vin III 147,.31 (mahā sakuṇasaṅgho tasmiṃ pallale divasaṃ ~aṃ caritvā); D III 23,.22 (tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā ~āya pakkameyyaṃ; Sv 827,.14 : āhāratthāya pakkameyyaṃ); Dhp 135 (yathā daṇḍena gopālo gāvo pacceti ~aṃ); Sn 39 (migo … yenicchakaṃ gacchati ~āya); Ja I 221,.31 (imasmiṃ sare udakaṃ parittaṃ ~o ca mando nidāgho ca mahanto); III 26,.2 (ekassa sīhassa … galo uddhumāyi, ~aṃ gaṇhituṃ na sakkoti); 52,.1 (attano ~-ṭṭhāne ~aṃ gahetvā); Mil 393,.14 (biḷāro āsanne yeva ~aṃ pariyesati); Ps I 117,.9 (jaraggavo divā ~e caritvā); Vv-a 218,.31 foll. (gāvo caranti etthā ti ~o, ~o viyā ti ~o ghāsesanaṭṭhānaṃ); Moh 167,.8 foll. (gāvo caranti etthā ti ~o gunnaṃ caraṇaṭṭhānaṃ, taṃsadisatāya pana sabbo pi pavattivisayo ~o ti veditabbo); Mhv 19:73 (rañño maṅgalahatthī … aṭṭhāsi ~aṃ caraṃ); — ifc see vana- (sv vana1), vāri-; — 2. a bhikkhu ’s begging-round; where bhikkhu s (properly) beg for food; Vin II 208,.22 (~o pucchitabbo agocaro pucchitabbo; Sp 1281,.5 : gocaragāmo āsanne udāhu dūre …); Pv 36:43 (addasā samaṇaṃ … paṭikkantaṃ ~ato nivattaṃ; Pv-a 240,.22 : piṇḍapātapaṭikkantaṃ, ten’ āha ~ato nivattan ti); Thī 427 (ayyā Jinadattā āgacchi ~āya caramānā; Thī-a 247,.28 : ~āyā ti bhikkhāya); Ap 294,.20; Vibh 247,.11 foll.; Sp 788,.3 (vesiyādi-agocaraṃ pahāya saddhāsampannakulādinā ca ~ena sampanno); Nidd-a I 451,.1 (~o ti piṇḍapātādīnaṃ atthāya upasaṅkamituṃ yuttaṭṭhānaṃ); — ifc see ācāra-, mahā- (s v maha[t]), vesiyā-; — ~-gāma, m., the village where bhikkhu s or other ascetics beg for food; a village where bhikkhu s can (properly) beg for food; M I 167,.6; Ja IV 8,.9 (ekaṃ indavāruṇikarukkhaṃ ~-gāmaṃ katvā); Vism 97,.29 (mettā bhāvetabbā … ~-gāmamhi issarajane); Sp 285,.16; 1267,.2 (amhākaṃ ~-gāme piṇḍāya caritvā); Ps II 174,.4 (sampattapabbajitānaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ ~-gāmaṃ ca addasaṃ); Pv-a 12,.18 (sundaro ’yaṃ ~-gāmo manussā ca saddhāsampannā paṇītaṃ piṇḍa-pātaṃ denti …); — 3. (i) where the mind (properly) ranges and finds sustenance; a field or scope or sphere of action or attention; D III 58,.19 (~e bhikkhave caratha sake pettike visaye; Sv 846,.20 : ~e ti carituṃ yuttaṭṭhāne); S V 148,.1 (ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno ~o sako pettiko visayo, yad idaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā); Dhp 22 (paṇḍitā appamāde pamodanti ariyānaṃ ~e ratā); 93 (suññato animitto ca vimokho yassa ~o) = Th 92; Sn 961 (kyāss’ assu idha ~ā); Th 1085 (accheraṃ vata buddhānaṃ gambhīro ~o sako); Ap 48,.10 (vinayo mayhaṃ ~o); Paṭis I 180,.6 (~aṃ ca pajānāti; Paṭis-a 512,.27 : ~an ti vipassanākhaṇe saṅkhārārammaṇaṃ, maggakkhaṇe ca phalakkhaṇe ca nibbānārammaṇaṃ); II 150,.13 (ime panca dhammā dhammapaṭisambhidāya ārammaṇā c’ eva honti ~ā ca); Vism 19,.16 (~o pana tividho upanissayagocaro ārakkhagocaro upanibandhagocaro ti); Sv 465,.15 (paṭibhaṃsū ti paṭibhāṇasaṅkhātassa ñāṇassa ~ā ahesuṃ); Paṭis-a 232,.30 (samādhissa ~esu kasiṇādīsu ārammaṇesu … chekabhāvo); — ifc see ārakkha-, upanibandha-, upanissaya-; — ~’-ajjhatta, (mf)n., what is internal as the scope of action or attention; a sphere of attention within oneself;? Spk III 206,.4 (~’-ajjhatte pavattāya satiyā); It-a II 168,.10 (ajjhattarato samāhito ti evamādisu vuttaṃ idaṃ ~’-ajjhattaṃ nāma); Th-a III 167,.6 (~’-ajjhatte suṭṭhu samāhitā hutvā); — (ii) the range of the organs of sense; an object of sense; Abh 94 (rūpaṃ saddo gandharasā phasso dhammo ca ~ā); Kv 252,.17 (maṃsacakkhussa visayo ānubhāvo ~o); Sv 224,.15 (āruppe pana dibbacakkhussa ~o n’ atthī ti); Vibh-a 47,.14 (cakkhādīnaṃ pana ~-ttā); — agocara, m. 1. not the proper feeding-ground; an unsuitable feeding-ground (for a particular animal); Ja II 40,.14 (imaṃ ṭhānaṃ tava agocaro); 60,.2 (tiracchānagatā pi agocare carantā sapattahatthaṃ gacchanti); Pj II 39,.15 (tā gāvo agocaraṃ pariharitvā gocare cāretvā); — 2. an unsuitable place for bhikkhu s to beg, an unsuitable person for bhikkhu s to beg from; Vin II 208,.22 (Sp 1281,.7 : agocaro nāma micchādiṭṭhikānaṃ vā gāmo paricchinnabhikkho vā gāmo); M I 11,.2 (yathārūpe anāsane nisinnaṃ yathārūpe agocare carantaṃ …; Ps I 80,.32 : ayutto gocaro agocaro, so vesiyādibhedo pañca-vidho); Nidd I 473,.8 foll.
